setlist_extra.title: That's It For The Other One
And We Bid You Good Night

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Other One** (2 reviews): First verse of The Other One has lyrics quite different from the usual ones; Weir sings early lyrics to The Other One [9][12]
- **Alligator** (1 review): Opening Alligator is top quality, with the band clearly enjoying it [7]
- **Cryptical Envelopment** (1 review): Cryptical Envelopment into The Other One and back into Cryptical is a nice sequence [9]
- **New Potato Caboose** (1 review): New Potato Caboose is sublime and moves incredibly into Born Cross-Eyed [3]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): Garcia's voice has a far-out effect on Dark Star, entered from the Spanish Jam [14]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): China Cat Sunflower shifts into overdrive at one standout point [3]

## Setlist highlights

- **Born Cross-Eyed**: rare: 14 archived performances [15]

## The recordings

- **gd68-01-22.sbd.weiner.8583.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 13 songs; 73 min; rated 4.53/5 by 32 [1]. Said about its sound: Neither source contains vocals for Caution; Reviewer finds the sound quality of the Alligator nice; Vocals are mixed weakly on Dark Star [1][6][7]
- **gd1968-01-22.sbd.miller.97342.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 12 songs; 73 min; rated 4.7/5 by 23 [2]. Said about its sound: Some static runs from the start through the reel flip in Born Cross-Eyed; Uploader guesses the Caution vocals were lost in the reel flip [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer notes this was the second night of the band's first Northwest tour [7]
- Teenage attendee who owned the first album expected blues covers like Sittin' On Top of the World, and was surprised [11]
- Continuous music left no room for applause; feedback left the crowd unsure if the show had ended, until it restarted [11]
- Listed as one of the shows contributing to the live mix on Anthem of the Sun [8]
- Reviewer sees it as peak garage-band Dead, before their sound refined and turned folkier in the early 1970s [10]
- Reviewer's favorite Spanish Jam; the nearly as long Tahoe 2/23 version never reaches this energy and color [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd68-01-22.sbd.weiner.8583.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Noah Weiner; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Source switches to higher-quality stereo 1:18 into Born Cross-Eyed; Main source stops 3:14 into Caution; the rest is crossfaded from a cassette copy of a soundboard reel [1]
- **gd1968-01-22.sbd.miller.97342.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> (4 Track) Master Reels -> Dat (44.1k) [2]. Also: Transfer comes from a DAT via Rob Eaton, with pitch correction help from Joe B. Jones [2]

## Art and photos

- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [gd68-01-22shnid97342back](https://www.flickr.com/photos/38838560@N04/4260164991/) [16]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/38838560@N04/4260164991/) [17]
